collection.name: Signal Artifacts / ARC / 001
collection.description: TapeBorn Genesis Collection — on-chain intelligence artifacts from Arc Testnet. Each token represents a verified, deterministic signal with full provenance and evidence.
collection.mintingPolicy: Admin-only via BUILD_010 pipeline. Additional tokens can be minted by the deployer wallet for verified signals.
collection.ownershipModel: Deployer wallet (0xCA672F44F5C6001C4e5Bf49DFFf9861276Bca22f) has minting authority. No renouncement planned at genesis.
collection.provenanceModel: Each token ID maps to a unique deterministic Signal ID (sig_<hash>). The Signal ID is derived from the source transaction, block, and signal type.
collection.artifactRelationship: Signal ID ↔ Token ID is 1:1. Provenance source transaction is distinct from NFT mint transaction.
collection.status: Genesis complete. Ready for future signal artifacts.

nextSteps: BUILD_016: Launch — public product + verified contracts + documentation
Mainnet readiness: update chainId and RPC in src/orchestrator/networks.js
Mainnet deployment: create dedicated wallet, run preflight, deploy
Post-launch: measure usage, improve signals, evaluate new chains
notes: Genesis supply is intentionally minimal (1 token) to validate the artifact pipeline.
Additional tokens can be minted as new signals are detected and verified.
No token sale or public minting is planned at this stage.
All metadata is on-chain via data URIs.
